name: std::extents<IndexType,Extents...>::fwd-prod-of-extents
intro: Returns the product of the sizes of extents with index less than i. The behavior is undefined if i <= rank() is false.

sections.title: Parameters
sections.text:
i

 -

 The end index of the range of extents to be multiplied together.

sections.title: Return value
sections.text: If i > 0 is true, return the product of extent(k) for all k in range [0, i), otherwise 1.

summary: Returns the product of the sizes of extents with index less than i. The behavior is undefined if i <= rank() is false.
